scope: Protocol references for explicitly negotiated independent transport profiles; no deployed provider or credentials tested

references.finding: AWS announced destination conditional CopyObject support on this date. Calling it unavailable in all current classic/general-purpose S3 is outdated.
Source CopySourceIfMatch is distinct from destination If-Match and If-None-Match. Full copy response validation remains necessary; HTTP status alone does not establish completed copy.
Destination If-Match and If-None-Match apply to PutObject as well as current CopyObject. A provider without destination copy conditions can instead expose truthful conditional PUT capabilities.
Conditional delete compares content ETags. This is not an object-incarnation or multi-object transaction guarantee.

profiles.modern-copy: Destination-conditional copy plus conditional delete; guarded PUT disabled
profiles.classic-put: Destination-conditional CopyObject unsupported and rejected by fixture; bounded conditional PutObject plus conditional delete supported
profiles.stream-put: Destination-conditional CopyObject unsupported; separately negotiated streaming read/conditional streaming PUT plus conditional delete supported

limits: Compatible providers may differ; capabilities must be explicit, truthful and enforced by the transport.
Mock enforcement proves integration logic, not a deployed provider or signing client's conformance.
Buffered fallback must remain within maxReadBytes; streaming fallback is separately negotiated, not an unbounded implicit buffer.
Metadata-only changes, same-content recreation and ABA can preserve ETag; directory enumeration is not a transaction.
